mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects may reduce skin barrier function and increase adapalene irritation/photosensitivity risk, while adapalene may exacerbate benztropine-induced xerosis and antimuscarinic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased dermatologic irritation, xerosis, and anticholinergic side effects; consider spacing administrations or dose adjustments if excessive dryness or irritation occurs.
